summary: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp. (a blank-check company, SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting that it received Nasdaq notice of regained compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) after filing its delayed Form 10-Q. No business combination, transaction, or special-situations event is described. The filing is a routine compliance update about timely SEC filings being filed and is not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or management change. The only event is the curing of a prior filing delinquency.
